name: flat
set:
Flat vector animation for a mobile explainer: simple geometric shapes, flat fills with no gradients, thin light outlines, a dark navy and teal palette with one warm accent, minimal detail, clean and graphic.

A small Victorian parlour on a stormy night. Mr White and Herbert sit over a chessboard at a round table by the fire; Herbert moves a piece and grins, Mr White frowns at the board. Rain streams down the tall window. Mr White is a thin man of sixty with a bald crown, grey hair at the sides, a long grey moustache and small round spectacles, in a dark green knitted cardigan over a white collarless shirt, brown trousers and slippers. Herbert is a tall cheerful young man of twenty-two with tousled chestnut hair, clean-shaven, in a white shirt with rolled sleeves, a mustard waistcoat and dark trousers. No text or captions. Vertical frame, the people in the upper two thirds.

name: storybook
set:
2D hand-drawn animated film in the manner of a gothic storybook: confident clean ink outlines, cel-shaded colour over painted gouache textures, richly detailed backgrounds, warm amber firelight against the cold blue of a rainy night, deep soft shadows, fluid full animation at 24 frames. England, 1902.

name: painted
set:
